updates.indicted: September 24, 1918 — U.S. District Court, District of Kansas, Second Division, Wichita.
updates.sentence:
Released from Leavenworth by order of court on June 17, 1921, before sentence expiration. This release is distinct from parole eligibility. Initial arrest and physical admission dates require further verification.

National Archives microfilm guide M2022, printed page2, individually names Robert Poe among the Wichita defendants. The indictment covered seditious conspiracy, obstruction of conscription, Espionage Act violations and interference with oil production under the Food and Fuel Control Act. Trial in Kansas City ran December1–18,1919 before John C.Pollock; Fred Robertson and Col.S.B.Amidon prosecuted. On May12,1921 the appellate court reversed count1 and affirmed counts2–4. These procedural dates do not establish physical admission or discharge. Source: https://twelvekey.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/m2022.pdf#page=3
